name: The Redford Center
summary: US nonprofit that sponsors independent environmental films, as pre-approved grants to the filmmaker. Media only.

evidence.quote: The Redford Center is one of the only US-based nonprofits
the charitable, tax-exempt purpose of our 501(c)(3), to advance education to improve society and the environment

projects.value: Films and media on environmental issues

evidence.quote: The project must be a film (documentary or narrative) or media project with the following characteristics, and in keeping with The Redford Center's mission: high impact and focused on Environmental issues

where.value: Not entities in Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria or parts of Ukraine; Russia and Venezuela case by case

evidence.quote: We are not able to fiscally sponsor entities based in countries which are under comprehensive US sanctions (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, and the following regions of Ukraine: Crimea, Donetsk, and Luhansk). There are also significant sanctions restrictions on the following countries: Russia; and Venezuela and will be case by case.
The applicant must be 18 years of age or older and an independent filmmaker or documentarian.

value.note: a film made partly in the US needs a director with a US tax number

evidence.quote: you do not need to be a U.S. citizen to apply, but if you are filming or producing any part of your film in the U.S. at least one of your directors will need to have a Social Security Number or an LLC
the fiscally sponsored project does not become a program that legally belongs to the sponsor and that is implemented by its employees
We also charge a $25 application fee to help cover the cost of screening administration.

fees.value: Card and PayPal fees on top

evidence.quote: credit cards and PayPal donations are charged a processing fee from those service providers that is in addition to our admin fee

min_income.value: A production budget of at least US$400,000; under that, ask first

evidence.quote: The production budget minimum to be eligible for our program is US$400,000. If you are under this number, please reach out before you apply

value.note: It receives grants and donations for the film and charges its fee on them.

evidence.quote: We charge an administrative fee for grants and donations received on behalf of sponsored projects.

value.note: your own salary can be in the budget

evidence.quote: We also expect and encourage you to include a fair and industry-standard salary for yourself in your project budget.

conditions.value: You own the copyright and have control of the work

evidence.quote: Applicant must be the content creator who owns the copyright of his/her work and has artistic, budgetary, and editorial control.
Student films produced through universities or colleges are not eligible for sponsorship.
Applicants will be expected to submit a fundraising plan along with our application.

form_asks.value: A detailed budget with revenue so far and prospects

evidence.quote: Your budget should also contain a revenue section which will share your fundraising revenue success to date, as well as a list of prospects and targets.

form_asks.value: Proof of access to the people and places in the film

evidence.quote: The applicant must be able to provided proof/documentation of access to the people, locations, or other specific subject matter of the film.
